name: Grilled Ribeye with Spicy Miso Sauce & Sesame Steamed Veggies

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ribeye steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, fill a large pot with 2-inches of hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.

While the water comes to a boil, peel and mince shallots. Place in a small bowl along with miso paste, chili-garlic sauce, oil, sesame seeds, sugar, and garlic powder. Stir to combine the spicy miso sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
¼ cup miso paste, white
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 tbsp sesame seeds
1 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, reduce heat to medium, then add cauliflower and broccoli. Re-cover and steam until veggies are fork tender, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (283 g) bags cauliflower florets
1 ½ (510 g) bags broccoli florets

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, drain and return to the pot. Drizzle with oil, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp sesame seeds
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates; drizzle steak with spicy miso sauce. Enjoy!
